newsitem.title: USA: Paxson says buys TV stations in Miami, Tampa.
newsitem.headline: Paxson says buys TV stations in Miami, Tampa.

text.p: Paxson Communications Corp said Monday that it is exercising its options to acquire Tampa's WFCT TV-66 and Miami's WCTD TV-35, which from the Christian Network Inc.
The purchase price was not disclosed. Paxon already operates both stations.
The company said Tampa and Miami are the nation's 15th and 16th largest television markets, respectively.
Paxson said these acquisitions continue the expansion of its nationwide television station group.

Including these and other pending acquisitions and divestitures, Paxson said it will own, operate or affiliate with 48 full-power television stations in markets containing over 54.5 million television households, or 55.7 percent of all U.S. television households.
